name: nonfinite-test-citations
brief: Re-anchor every source-location citation in the doc comments of FloorMapDrawableNonFiniteTests.cs (26 citations on 14 /// lines at 40dddd1, 22 of them drifted) on its enclosing member and statement, with the line number kept only as 'as numbered at 40dddd1' (decision E1), and re-check the claims those comments rest on. Five claims are corrected: the 'one arithmetic operation' summary, two 'persisted CanvasPoint' statements that CanvasPoint's finiteness guard and the handler's catch falsify, the 'not re-measured' sentence, and the Tokens.xaml 'comment block' wording. Nine true claims are kept and re-measured. Only /// lines change, the file stays CRLF, and the build and all three test suites stay green. One task (T1, sir-test-engineer). The backlog row asking for this re-measure is removed at Gate 3, and observations O1-O4 are reported there.
